scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:render: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run payload:types && npm --prefix frontend run payload:seed && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t subscrr-backend ./backend && docker build -t subscrr-frontend ./frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
